name: Paper review
description: A writer and two reviewers in parallel, one for the methods, one for the reader.

methods reviewer.duty: Judge the methods and the numbers: is every claim supported by a result, every statistic right, every figure reproducible from the data described? You do not rewrite the text.

reader.duty: Read it as a busy scientist from a neighbouring field: where did you get lost, what is said twice, what is missing to follow the argument? Say where, in a list. You do not rewrite the text.
